ClientLocalization.text: Keeps your bytes tight and your bits fit
Digital extremists stand no chance when you have Anti-V on your side
Keeping software safe by ALWAYS WATCHING
Get rid of malware, spyware, wetware and worms

Amplify shockwaves of devastating sound with this Technocyte virus infested shotgun that hungers for blood, and desires nothing more than to feed upon its enemies. Alternative fire at enemies not vulnerable to Mercy Kills to swarm them with infested mites, while firing at vulnerable ones will perform a ranged execution.

Get the job done right with a pair of spore flinging terror tools. Inflicts a spore that spreads to nearby enemies on death causing <DT_FREEZE_COLOR>Cold Status Effect and increased vulnerability to damage from the Torxica.
When the magazine reaches empty and is manually reloaded, the Coda Catabolyst launches not one but three powerful grenades. Also has a higher Status Chance, Damage, and Magazine Size.
The Coda Caustacyst scythe is a force to be reckoned with, the Technocyte virus honing it with improved Damage, Status Chance, and Critical Damage, as well as acid pools with longer duration.
The Technocyte virus did nothing but increase the Hema’s thirst for blood. With increased Fire Rate, Magazine Size, Critical Chance, Critical Damage, Status Chance, and Damage.
Rip and shred your enemies to pieces with the Coda Hirudo. With improved Damage, Status Chance, Critical Chance, and Critical Damage.
The Plague Year of 1999 will never be the same. With improved Critical Multipler, Critical Chance, and Status Chance, the Technocyte virus has turned the Coda Mire into a truly horrifying blade.

Enhanced by Technocyte mutations, the Coda Pathocyst comes with increased Damage, Critical Chance, Critical Damage and Status Chance. While in-flight or on contact with the enemy, it will occasionally spawn enhanced, enemy-seeking miasmites.
These festering, writhing, throwable projectiles of pus and gas have been improved with a greater Magazine Size, Critical Chance, Critical Damage, Status Chance, and Damage.
Delivers a virus-laden barb to its victim that continues to damage it before exploding. With increased Damage, Reload Speed, Magazine Size, Status Chance, and explosion radius.
Firing a nonstop stream of vile corrosive gastric juice, the Coda Synapse comes with increased Magazine size, Beam Length, Status Chance, Punch Through, and Damage.
The Technocyte virus has contorted this Tysis into a more lethal weapon. With increased Damage, Critical Chance, Critical Damage and Magazine Capacity.
Drive home the pain with this hammer evolved from a scooter assembly. The wheel shapeshifts and gains a unique buff to match whatever type of physical damage it has been modded for.
Gain |STAT|% weapon Critical Chance for |DURATION|s, when using abilities to inflict <DT_FIRE_COLOR>Heat Status effect on enemies. Maximum |MAX_STACKS|x stacks.
On Ability Cast: Next Ability cast gains +|BONUS|% Ability Strength, stacking up to |MAX_STACKS|x. Resets when the same ability is recast consecutively.
While sliding or aim gliding: Gain |AMMO_EFFICIENCY|% ammo efficiency with Dual Pistols.
Battery Recharge Delay is reduced by |val|%

spawn volatile hives for |DURATION|s that explode when enemies approach for |DAMAGE| <DT_FIRE_COLOR>Heat Damage in |RANGE|m. Standing in the area applies <DT_FIRE_COLOR>Heat Damage type to Theorem Arcanes.

Standing in a zone created by a Residual Arcane increases damage of companions and summoned allies within |RANGE|m by |DAMAGE|%/s stacking up to |AMOUNT|x. Effect persists for |DURATION|s upon leaving the zone.
While Buffing Ally Warframes: +|VALUE|% Critical Chance per buff
On swapping to Secondary Weapon, consume all Combo Multipliers to increase Secondary Weapon Critical Chance and Critical Damage by |STAT_VALUE|% per Combo consumed for |DURATION|s.
Generate Void Particles every |DELAY|s up to |COUNT| particles, each granting |AMOUNT|% Damage Reduction for |DURATION|s. Taking damage consumes a particle.
Heal yourself and allies within Affinity Range |VALUE| Health for each Energy point spent on the initial casting cost of abilities.
Gain +|BONUS| Max Health per active channeled ability.
Increase <DT_FIRE_COLOR>Heat Damage in Operator Mode by |AMOUNT|% for |DURATION|s, stacking up to |COUNT|x.
Reduce Enemy Resistance to <DT_FIRE_COLOR>Heat Damage by |AMOUNT|%.
create a frigid mist for |DURATION|s, dealing |DAMAGE| <DT_FREEZE_COLOR>Cold Damage/s. Standing in the area applies <DT_FREEZE_COLOR>Cold Damage to Theorem Arcanes.

spawn an electrified spike for |DURATION|s, dealing |DAMAGE| <DT_ELECTRICITY_COLOR>Electricity Damage to enemies within |RANGE|m. Standing in the area applies <DT_ELECTRICITY_COLOR>Electricity Damage to Theorem Arcanes.
Gain |DAMAGE_PERCENT|% Melee Damage for every |SHIELD_NUM| current Shields, up to |DAMAGE_PERCENT_LIMIT|%. Bonus halved for Overshields.
WHILE IN VOID SLING: Press <PRE_ATTACK> to dissipate the endpoint in a |RADIUS|m radius. Enemies hit create a short lived Void Mote that replenishes |ENERGY| Energy on pick up.
On Warframe Melee Transference: Heavy Blades deal +|CRIT_BONUS|% Critical Damage for |NUM_ATTACKS| consecutive attacks. Cooldown |COOLDOWN|s.
Reduce Enemy Resistance to <DT_PUNCTURE_COLOR>Puncture Damage by |AMOUNT|%.
Enemies within |DISTANCE|m are pulled towards Warframe.
Use again within |DURATION|s, to return the Operator to their original position at no energy cost. Restores |AMOUNT| Health. |COOLDOWN|s cooldown.
Stun robotic enemies for |DURATION|s, which then discharge <DT_ELECTRICITY_COLOR>Electricity Damage dealing |HEALTH|% of their Max Health to anyone within |DISTANCE|m.
|NUM| projectiles burst from the target and seek the heads of nearby enemies.

Standing in a zone created by a Residual Arcane creates a globe that orbits the player every |TICK|s. The globes will strike the nearest enemy within |RANGE|m dealing |DAMAGE| damage increasing their vulnerability to the globe's damage type by |DEBUFFAMOUNT|% for |DEBUFFTIME|s. Globes will persist for |DURATION|s upon leaving the zone.
Drop a mine that tethers up to |COUNT| enemies in |RANGE|m for |DELAY|s.
create pool of toxic blood for |DURATION|s, dealing |DAMAGE| <DT_POISON_COLOR>Toxin Damage/s. Standing in the area applies the <DT_POISON_COLOR>Toxin Damage to Theorem Arcanes.
Standing in a zone created by a Residual Arcane increases weapon damage by |DAMAGE|%/s stacking up to |AMOUNT|x. Effect persists for |DURATION|s upon leaving the zone.
The Acrid fires an acidic-infused needle.
The SUPRA is a heavy laser gun with a short wind up time.
Laser Rifle with Corpus safe-guards removed.
Ignis produces a stream of intense heat.
The Penta Launcher fires up to five grenades that can be remotely triggered at just the right moment.
The Prova is a Melee Weapon that delivers a high-intensity shock to its target.
The Lanka fires a high velocity projectile through magnetic induction.
While its intended design is for deep space construction, the concentrated laser beam of the Spectra is highly effective against organic and synthetic enemies.
Oxylus Sentinel will automatically pick any plants within |RANGE|m over <LOWER_IS_BETTER>|DURATION|s.
Wield the timeless power of this mighty hammer. Heavy Attacks performed with Ekhein temporarily increase its Damage and Attack Speed.
Increases maximum Void Sling distance by |val|%.

Standard tool for cutting ore and gems out of stone.

Travel far from Hub settlements for the best chance of mining rare minerals.

A more accurate variation of the Nosam Cutter.

Travel far from Hub settlements for the best chance of mining rare minerals.

Enhanced with cybernetics, this tool is able to locate nearby gems and ore veins and has chance to retrieve Rare Gems on any Landscape.

Travel far from Hub settlements for the best chance of mining rare minerals.
Dismounting deals |DAMAGE| <DT_FREEZE_COLOR>Cold Damage to enemies within |RADIUS|m.
Executing tricks charges Energy: |VALUE| Energy per 100 Trick Points.
Gain invulnerability for |DURATION|s mounting a K-drive, but will expire early upon dismounting.
Fireworks trigger when completing a trick over |POINTS| points.
Tap and hold Grind in the air to execute a |RADIUS|m radius Slam Shockwave that deals |DAMAGE| damage.
For the Arbiters of Hexis these pistols are more than simple weapons, they are symbols of truth and discipline.
Spinning attacks unleash the Stormpath, a tempest of mayhem that hurls any foes in its way.
Bring down judgement, with this boltor crafted by the Arbiters of Hexis.
Furis pistols equipped in each hand. Twice the Magazine Capacity and slightly faster Fire Rate, but Accuracy and Reload Speed are lowered.
A Bolto equipped in each hand. Twice the Magazine Capacity and slightly faster Fire Rate, but reload time is doubled and accuracy is lowered.
A Bronco equipped in each hand.
A Lato equipped in each hand. Twice the Magazine Capacity and Fire Rate, but Reload time is doubled and Accuracy is lowered.
The devastating power of the Soma rifle compacted into two elegant pistols.
A Viper equipped in each hand.
Dual Lex pistols double the amount of high caliber lead you can throw at the enemy, but accuracy and reload time suffer.
Twice the ammo and twice the stopping power of a single Magnus.
This Orokin variation of the Ankyros is superior to its successor in every way.
Evoking the design of ancient bows, the high impact Cernos is perfect for hunting down highly shielded enemies.
Diriga shocks nearby enemies, and picks off distant threats, utilizing the Vulklok sniper rifle and the 'Calculated Shot', 'Arc Coil' and 'Electro Pulse' precepts.
Sentinel will zap up to |TARGETS| enemies within |RANGE|m, dealing |DAMAGE| <DT_ELECTRICITY_COLOR>Electricity Damage with a |PROC|% Status Chance.
This laser bladed battle-axe easily hacks through a ship's defenses and the forces protecting it.
Unload deadly accurate bursts of mayhem.
When fully charged, this flak cannon delivers a devastating shot. Perfect for taking down fast-moving interceptors.
Using Archwing's jets for thrust, this massive hammer crushes anything in its path.
Delivering twin streams of highly accurate, rapid-fire ordnance, the Decurion are specifically designed for combat in the vacuum of space.
Tear apart incoming enemies with this massive hooked blade.
Devastate free-space enemies with Phaedra, the Soma's big-sister.
A long range rifle capable of firing in space, the Imperator's versatility makes it an ideal weapon for space combat.
When fully charged, the magnetized barrel of the Velocitus accelerates a metal slug to tremendous speeds, piercing hulls and obliterating armor.
An Archwing energy weapon that sends waves of deadly plasma crashing into enemies.
Become an angel of death, with this Archwing scythe.
Weightless space turns this impossibly massive sword into an agile instrument of destruction.
Part sword, part shield, the Centaur excels at charging headlong into enemy fire.
Creates a localized storm of punishing explosions.
Daikyu takes great strength to draw back, but provides added power and range to every shot.
The Ballistica crossbow features a unique dual firing mechanism. Choose between a four bolt volley or a deadly accurate charged shot.
The Furis delivers a high damage output in a short time frame thanks to its high rate of fire.
A shotgun with low accuracy and strong recoil, but able to deliver its payload in full-auto. The Boar is best used at close range.
Downward cuts with an impact combo.
Enemies within |RANGE|m are drawn to you. Once they are within |FATAL_RANGE|m, they detonate for |DAMAGE| Damage. Kill them before detonation to increase lure time and reduce cooldown.
Launches a plodding missile capable of unleashing a massive explosion.
A classic Orokin weapon, Bo Prime creates elegant fury on the battlefield.
One of the finest examples of Tenno craftsmanship, the Boar Prime offers a higher Fire Rate, Magazine Capacity and a much higher per-shot damage.
The Boltor fires slow, heavy bolts that are capable of impaling enemies to walls.
An intimidating Tonfa set designed to match the briary design of the Boltor.
Fires Orokin designed bolts that are faster and sharper.
Converts Secondary ammo pickups to |PERCENT|% of Ammo Pick Up.
These coverings for the hands and feet allow devastating high flying hand-to-hand combat attacks without risking harm to the user.
A classic Orokin weapon, Braton Prime features modified damage levels and a larger magazine over the standard model.
These iron fists that rip through foes are Atlas' signature weapons. When wielded by Atlas they receive a Status Chance increase.
Infused with rare Orokin alloys, the Bronco Prime is a highly efficient weapon, trading an increased Magazine Capacity and damage for a lower rate of fire.
Fires a small burst of lasers.
The Sicarus fires 3-round bursts, which provides a balance between the lethality of auto-pistols and the accuracy of semi-automatic pistols.
The Burston fires 3-round bursts, which provides a balance between the lethality of automatic rifles and the accuracy of semi-automatic rifles.
This intelligent hammer takes an enemy killed by a Heavy Attack and recomposes them as an ally. Any fatal strike with this weapon also performs a Codex scan.
Deployed by the Cephalon Suda, once a data-analyzing instrument the Gammacor main focus is defense.
Cephalon Suda's custom issue Simulor was built to satisfy her curiosity.
Carrier will attack the first visible enemy within |RANGE|m.
With 'Assault Mode' and 'Ammo Case' as default Precepts, Carrier is a seeker Sentinel. Carrier also comes with a shotgun weapon.
Adarza Kavat grants |CRIT|% increased critical chance for |DURATION|s to allies within |RANGE|m every <LOWER_IS_BETTER>|COOLDOWN|s.
Smeeta Kavat becomes invisible for |DURATION|s every <LOWER_IS_BETTER>|COOLDOWN|s while a decoy kavat draws fire. Decoy has a |EVASION|% chance to evade damage and blinds nearby enemies on death.
Smeeta Kavat has a |CHANCE|% chance every <LOWER_IS_BETTER>|INTERVAL|s to bestow its owner with good fortune.
The Kavat stakes their territory in a radius of |RANGE|m for |DURATION|s. Each second, enemies within this area have a 30% chance of being attacked by a shadow Kavat.
The Kavat pounces at an enemy, dealing |DAMAGE|% Damage and stunning them for a short duration.
Adarza Kavat has a |STAT1|% chance to reflect damage back to an enemy, amplifying it by |STAT2|%.
A vicious attack dealing |PERCENT|% damage that sunders armor by |ARMOUR|% and rends flesh.
When its Master is bleeding out, the Vasca Kavat sacrifices <LOWER_IS_BETTER>|VAL|% of its Health to raise them.
The Kavat senses the weaknesses of enemies within 25m. For 25s, its attacks deal +|DAMAGE|% damage and stagger with a 30% chance of knockdown.
Vasca Kavat inflicts |STACKS| stacks of <DT_SLASH_COLOR>Slash at |DAMAGE|% of its melee damage and restores |HEAL|% Health to itself.
Obtain enlightenment with this massive hammer that performs a Codex scan on each fatal strike. Scans require an equipped Codex Scanner and an available charge.
Creates miniature gravitational singularities that can be used for scientific study or self-defense.
This short blade weapon was built using ceramic. It has limited range but comes out fast.
The Amprex rifle fires a continuous beam of high voltage electricity that arcs among nearby enemies. This weapon excels at Crowd Control.
Unleashes a |RANGE|m radial blast of <DT_FREEZE_COLOR>Cold when multiple enemies are nearby. Add 3 stacks. 10s cooldown.
The sleek lines of the Detron conceal its ferocious nature. The hand cannon's semi-automatic action takes down enemies with speed and efficiency.
Capable of firing multiple rockets at once, the Angstrum is a handheld instrument of destruction.
Compact and deadly, the Cestra discharges bolts of energy at an increasingly rapid rate.
Developed as an energy saw to scrap obsolete ships, this tool was quickly banned when rebels in the Sedna region discovered it also made an excellent weapon.
The Obex system multiplies the kinetic energy of a Tenno's kicks and punches, delivering devastating blows to any target.
Drawing from its huge quad-chambered magazine, the Tetra is capable of unleashing a sustained barrage of lethal energy bolts.
Half taser, half whip. The Corpus Lecta delivers a deadly shock to anything it touches.
The Dakra Prime is a Tenno forged weapon, crafted during the time of the Orokin. It is renowned for speed, power and the ability to hit multiple targets.
A strong blade forged using ceramic.
The Bolto fires slow, heavy bolts that are capable of impaling enemies to walls.
Unleashes a |RANGE|m radial knockdown when multiple enemies are nearby, dealing |DAMAGE| Damage.
Blasts targets with a massive wave of sonic energy. Results reported to be: 'Very Satisfying'.
Once charged this Corpus laser cannon dispatches a devastating blast of light energy.
Send a massive charge of potential energy hurling toward unfortunate targets.
Fires a photon beam that halts molecular vibrations, causing instant and painful freezing.
This weapon was designed to assist with the excavation of mineral deposits from large asteroids, but has been adapted for military purposes.
When its twin-lasers converge on a target a circuit is created, frying the subject.
Like the surge and crash of storm waves, a master of the Nami cutlass and Skyla dagger turns these two separate weapons into one fluid attack.
This short blade weapon forged using dark metals has limited range but comes out fast.
Use as a devastating heavy sword or apply a Dual Melee stance and split the weapon into two ferocious blades.
A blade forged using dark metals, capable of delivering innate <DT_RADIATION_COLOR>Radiation Damage with attacks.
This heavy duty Archwing was designed for one purpose, destruction.
A customized version of the Dera, featuring a metallic finish and Lotus decal.
With 'Assault Mode' and 'Vaporize' as default precepts, Dethcube acts exactly as advertised, as a badass cube of 'deth'. Comes loaded with Deth Machine Rifle weapon.
Standard issue weaponry signature to Dethcube.
A gift from the Lotus to commemorate the anniversary of the first Tenno waking from Cryo stasis.
A gift from the Lotus to commemorate the anniversary of the first Tenno waking from Cryo stasis.
A gift from the Lotus to commemorate the third anniversary of the first Tenno waking from Cryo stasis.
Djinn will attack the first visible enemy within |RANGE|m.
With 'Thumper' and 'Fatal Attraction' as default Precepts, Djinn is a combat Sentinel. Djinn also comes with a poison dart weapon.
The Dragon Nikana is forged from ancient Tenno steel. This is a master's weapon, only the most worthy of Tenno may wield it.
Forged by a master gunsmith, this Tenno burst rifle will strike down targets with swift precision.
Short axes held in each hand. High attack speed and can hit multiple targets. Delivers a high percentage of critical strikes.
Wield two Cestras to unleash a dual torrent of high energy bolts.
These matching stilettos have increased attack speed and can unleash a flurry of multi-hit attacks.
Strong, focused attacks with multi-hit spins.
A shorter version of the Ether blade that allows for a more focused attack on a single target.
Fast and precise. The Dual Ether cuts so cleanly that it was considered by the Tenno to be a more humane weapon for ‘cleansing' infested allies. Capable of hitting multiple targets.
With a Heat Sword in each hand, enemies reach their fiery demise twice as fast. Can connect with multiple targets at once.
Wielding a Kama in each hand brings a savage amount of <DT_SLASH_COLOR>Slash Damage to bear against your enemies.
A shorter Skana in each hand. Can hit multiple targets.
Multi-angle strikes and deadly thrust attacks.
Vasto revolvers equipped in each hand.
The Warframe emits a massive pulse of energy, stunning nearby enemies and sending them flying.
The Dera is a repeater that fires super-heated plasma.
With a blade forged from the same material as the Ether Sword, the Ether Reaper delivers quick death to its victims.
A single blade for more precision. The Ether Sword cuts so cleanly that it was considered by the Tenno to be a more humane weapon for ‘cleansing' infested allies.
Vents out the Archwing's propulsion core, confusing enemy projectiles and causing them to detonate.
Core Vent Augment: <DT_EXPLOSION_COLOR>Blast Damage ignites exhaust fumes for |DURATION|s. Enemies passing through the flames take |DAMAGE| <DT_FIRE_COLOR>Heat Damage.
A set of ceremonial daggers from the Orokin era, the Fang Prime's blades resonate violently as they strike. This allows them to pierce hardened materials like armor with ease.
Forms a protective energy shell around the Warframe
Energy Shell Augment: Energy Shell applies to allies within |val|m.
These power gauntlets lack the range of most Melee Weapons, but Furax is far more devastating when you strike an enemy in close combat.
Fast, multi-hit strikes with powerful finishers.
Scope out the enemy with this long-range revolver style rifle.
Drops flare beacons confusing incoming guided missiles.
During the darkest days of the Old War many a Tenno relied solely on the Tonbo to keep them alive.
These Wraith gauntlets have been augmented for power.
Consumed in the fusion process to power up existing Mods.
The Marelok combines the stopping power of a rifle with the portability of a pistol.
With pinpoint accuracy, the Grinlok lever-action repeating rifle can easily find the soft spot on any target.
When Ghost invisibility is broken, Shade's owner is granted +|DAMAGE|% Weapon Damage for |DURATION|s.
Cloaks owner when enemies are within |RANGE|m. The cloak is disrupted if owner attacks.
The Gorgon Wraith is a powerful variant of its precursor that features unique styling.
The heavy two-handed sword known as Gram requires great strength to wield, but it is notorious for its splitting power. Can hit multiple targets with each strike.
Designed as a pair, these Grineer sidearms fire projectiles at a slower rate but with greater force and accuracy.
Equipped with a huge Magazine and impressive Fire Rate, the Grakata is the preferred weapon of Grineer Lancers.
Built for close combat, the Sheev's plasma blade slices through flesh and armor with equal ease.
Sobek is a rapid-firing Grineer shotgun that has reduced damage per shot but boasts extra large magazine capacity.
Butcher your foes with brutal blades in each hand.
The Drakgoon flak cannon sends volleys of intensely hot shrapnel ricocheting around the room. Can be fired in wide or concentrated bursts.
Firing a sticky, toxic, explosive compound, the Stug Gel Gun offers multiple ejection modes, delivering maximum damage in all situations.
Simple but powerful. The semi-automatic Brakk hand cannon delivers a lot of punch in a small package.
The Kraken is a heavy pistol of Grineer design that fires two quick shots with a single pull of the trigger. Skilled marksmen will appreciate the value in this deadly accurate weapon.
Deliver crushing blows with this Grineer built, jet powered mace.

A full-auto pistol known as the most compact and lightweight weapon of the Grineer arsenal. Though it has a small Magazine Capacity, the Viper has a very high Fire Rate and ultra-fast reload times thanks to a simplified magazine design.
Solid, dependable and deadly. The Karak is a standard issue rifle in many Grineer platoons.
A ferocious Melee Weapon crafted by the Grineer and carried by their elite melee forces.
Creates and focuses a high-frequency field of microwaves, literally cooking the target from within.
The Miter launches high velocity saw blades, tearing apart anyone unfortunate enough to be in their path.
Built by the Grineer for their elite troopers, the Vulkar is a devastating distance weapon. In the right hands it is capable of taking down targets long before they get into attack range.

Fashioned with Grineer materials and balanced for marine infantry use, the Amphis is a traditional staff weapon that has received a monstrous makeover that enables shock damage on jump attacks. Connects with multiple enemies with each strike.
Shatter your targets with explosive shells from this devastating Archwing cannon.
Gallium-alloy gauntlets for close-range Archwing combat. Designed by the infamous Tyl Regor.
This jet powered Grineer throwing mace always comes back to its master and is even capable of disarming targets.
These nasty, little hatchets slice through steel as if it were flesh.
Mark your targets and unleash a barrage of bullets, the Buzlok's homing rounds always find the enemy. Marked targets are more likely to take critical hits.
Hurl mayhem and destruction with this Grineer grenade launcher.
Spike enemies to the wall or reel them in with this burst harpoon gun.
This particle cannon generates a condensed beam of super-heated plasma designed to melt rock to ore, and enemies to molten slag.
For every shot fired in rapid succession the Kohm releases an additional bolt and grows more lethal.
Rain hell on the enemy with this handheld cluster-rocket launcher.
Inflict maximum devastation with this massive Grineer trident.
A multi-bladed whip that is adept at flaying skin from bone. In extreme cases, disobedient Grineer are sentenced to death by Atterax.
Like the larger Kohm, this hand-shotgun doubles its volley with each successive shot.
Boosts owner's shield by |BOOST|% when it runs out.
Bullets spray between wicked slash attacks.
A large two-handed hammer, the Fragor requires great strength to wield, but impacts with enough force to send groups of enemies tumbling.
Methodical strikes and high impact combos.
Aerial attacks with Crowd Control combos.
The Bronco is a small-scale shotgun that can be wielded with one hand. Only effective at close range, it has a limited Magazine Capacity.
The choice weapon of Mirage, these fast-firing dual pistols deliver a deadly performance.
Sentinel charges a powerful shot and fires at the first enemy within |RANGE|m.
This short blade weapon has limited range but comes out fast and can inflict fire damage.
A strong blade capable of inflicting <DT_SLASH_COLOR>Slash Damage to its foes.
The Scindo is a heavy war axe crafted by the Tenno. Reduced speed and agility is balanced by heavy, devastating strikes capable of connecting with multiple targets at once.
The Lex is a powerful, accurate pistol that has a low Fire Rate and Magazine Capacity. Very efficient at long range.
The Gorgon sports a large magazine that allows it to provide suppressing fire and sustain a high damage rate over a long time. Its high Fire Rate is only achieved following a short wind-up cycle.
Causes the Helios Sentinel to attack enemy targets using pieces of itself.
The Helminth Charger rushes an enemy, dealing |DAMAGE| Damage to all in its path. It gains +|BUFF|% Melee Damage, Max Health and Armor for every enemy hit for |DURATION|s.
A powerful mid-range rifle used by Grineer shock troops, the Hind fires in five round bursts.

Based on one of the world's oldest weapon designs, this Tenno-crafted weapon can be used both in stealth and in open combat. The Paris uses a chargeable magnetic field to launch arrows capable of impaling enemies to walls.
Ice in motion can crush mountains, this frozen hammer is no different.
The Imperator Vandal has been customized by the Tenno with a blue-green metallic finish and Lotus branding on the barrel.

A bizarre union of Corpus technology and Infested biology, this automatic rifle can also deploy an irradiated airborne infested mass. Further field testing is required to fully understand the potential of this weapon.
These festering sacs of pus and gas burst violently on impact.
Completely overwhelmed by Infested biology, this former Quanta now fires organic ordnance and a harpoon like appendage.
Overcome with Infestation, this bow's arrows now spread poisonous contagion to any surface they hit.
The Tysis pistol spits out caustic darts that corrode their victims from within.
Brain-strikes excite this bioweapon, causing it to rapidly release toxic munitions.
A living weapon, the infested Embolist pistol kills its victims with an acidic venomous gas.
Powered by a bio-chemical reaction, the Infested Synapse rifle fries its targets with a steady stream of <DT_CORROSIVE_COLOR>Corrosive energy.
Fires seven beams of continuous biochemical energy which depletes the life of any surface they contact.
An instrument of unrelenting harm. If Lesion tastes blood, it becomes invigorated with faster Attack Speed and increased <DT_POISON_COLOR>Toxin Damage.
The Scoliac Whip is a nasty parasitic growth of sinew and bone that can inflict heart stopping <DT_POISON_COLOR>Toxin Damage with attacks.
Helios Sentinel will scan objects and enemies within |RANGE|m over |DURATION|s. This consumes Codex Scanner charges.
Fast cutting attacks with puncture finish.
Dethcube drops an Energy Orb after assisting in <LOWER_IS_BETTER>|ASSISTS| kills.
Increases Ammo Capacity by |CAPACITY|% and converts Ammo Pickups into ammo for equipped weapons after |DELAY|s.
A blade with a serrated edge that delivers strong quick attacks.
A different take on the Grineer assault rifle, the Karak Wraith features unique styling.
The Nikana reintroduces a lost Tenno blade and with it another fragment of the old ways.
Reverse grip style emphasizing slashing and impaling strikes.
The Kestrel boomerang is a heavy throwing weapon that can knock down enemies at a distance.
The kubrow charges at a target, dragging them and dealing |DAMAGE|% damage to all in its path.
The kubrow cloaks itself and its master to stalk down its prey when they are within |RANGE|m.
The kubrow sniffs out buried objects and digs them up.
The kubrow roars, causing enemies within |RANGE|m to stumble and drop their weapons.
The kubrow cries out with a blood-curdling howl that strikes fear into |COUNT| enemies within |RANGE|m for |DURATION|s.
The Kubrow rushes at |COUNT| enemies within |RANGE|m, dealing damage and knocking them over.
Helminth Charger whips a proboscis out at an enemy within |RANGE|m, pulling them back and dealing |DAMAGE| damage.
Kubrow has |CHANCE|% chance to scavenge additional loot from a fallen enemy or containers within |RANGE|m, every |COOLDOWN|s.
Heal your Companion with Melee hits. Excess healing grants Overguard.
The kubrow comes to the defense of its master, replenishing both of their shields by |BOOST|% of its maximum shields and adding its shield regeneration rate to its master's for |DURATION|s.
|val|% chance for the pet to pry open a locked locker.
The kubrow hunts for Eximus units protected by Overguard within |RANGE|m and deals +300% Damage against Overguard.
Kunai throwing daggers offer a silent alternative to the traditional side arm. Perfect for assassins.
A laser rifle developed by reverse-engineering Corpus technology.
The Lato is a highly accurate pistol used by the Tenno everywhere. Prime model offers slightly increased damage.
The ornamental Latron Prime exploits ancient Orokin technology to get a slight damage increase over the standard Latron.
Consumed in the fusion process to power up existing Mods. A single Legendary Core will instantly fuse a Mod to its maximum capacity without credit cost.

Forgo ammunition with the regenerating energy disc in this plasma throwing pistol.
A cutting-edge, halogen-cooled electron accelerator capable of snap-freezing a target in moments.

Dominate rivals with this pistol’s lightning fast rail-slugs. Head-shots speed up reload.
A special-order Corpus cutting tool for master crafters only. Features distinctive azurite plating and a focusing crystal of precision clarity and cut.

Corpus ingenuity leveraging Tau-tech to create a high-capacity bi-modal sniper weapon of terrifying capability. Zoom in to reduce recoil and add punch through. Zoom again to fire a bursting viral round, but with a lower rate of fire. Komorex features built-in ammo conversion.
Feel the kick of this Corpus shotgun as it shatters a high-yield crystal into anyone and anything standing in your way.

The versatile Cinta can fire arrows in quick succession, quickly charge a shock wave, or fully charge a powerful focused shot.

A silent, pistol-style Amp for the Drifter. Generates its own ammunition from Void energy. A precisely timed reload over-charges the next shot.
An electrified jolter for quick melee takedowns, assembled from scavenged scrap. Ideal for use on unsuspecting opponents.
Battlefield butchery becomes all too easy with a Krohkur blade in each hand.
This Heavy Scythe echoes battles of another time. It is far more a weapon of sheer force than one of finesse.
This unusual automatic rifle feels strangely familiar and has two fire modes. Primary fire packs radiation damage. Alternate fire charges up to launch an explosive projectile.
Albrecht's Void experiments revealed the true destructive potential of this fist weapon. In Incarnon form, perform Heavy Slams to impale nearby enemies with spikes.

A blood-red variant of this destructive flamethrower.

Tear and maim with this agile, lightweight glass hammer. When Gara's wields her signature melee weapon, it gains additional Slam Radial Damage.

Detonate heads with this slow-firing rifle that rewards precision.

A different take on the throwing mace, the Halikar Wraith features unique styling.
Rain down a triple volley of explosive disease bladders from a distance, then move in for the kill by unloading a multi-shot barrage of toxic barbs with primary fire.

Reconfigured for maximum lethality, the Kuva Grattler still shatters targets with explosive shells, but now reaches maximum fire-rate instantaneously.

Double-fist rapid-fire bursts of pain with these dual-wield variants of the Grineer submachine gun. Higher Fire Rate and Magazine Capacity.

Put them down so that they stay down, with this Scaldra slug launcher.

Take active defense to new heights with this deadly flying shield and brutal blade. Throw the shield with a unique Heavy Attack, inflicting Blast Status Effects and dealing damage in a wide area.

Embrace pandemonium. Chainfire and explosive potential meet in Larkspur Prime. Hildryn packs more ammo when she wields this mighty weapon.

The glorious original Orokin casting of Gara’s signature glass hammer. Deceptively light and swift, while remaining lethally effective.

Caliban’s signature scythe, forged from a limb wrenched off a fallen Eidolon centuries ago. 50% increased Melee Combo Counter Chance when wielded by Caliban.

Turn foes into puppets with Teshin’s versatile throwing disc.

Blast through enemies with a double-barreled shot of energized slugs. This siphons their life essence which is then used to generate the secondary fire's massive air-burst mortar. The ancient Entrati weapon was built for Necramechs but also functions as an Archgun.

An ancient weapon designed by the Entrati for use by their Necramechs. Primary fire siphons life essence from the target to fuel a devastating secondary fire. Unload percussive machine gun fire, or strike a heavy chord with a single charge shot. When Octavia wields her signature rifle alt-fire Headshot Kills have a chance to instantly refill the magazine.

Bring hell to the battlefield with Uriel's signature rifle and bayonet combination. Occupying both primary and melee slots, this unique weapon blends precision marksmanship with unrelenting melee combat.

Flick away the enemy with this heavy warfan. The Quassus scatters ethereal daggers that are even more deadly accurate when wielded by Xaku.
Launch a volley of virulent, hyper-pressurized, water globules that envelope targets and explode with torrential force. Yareli's signature pistol.
Tear and chew through enemies with this unusual crankshaft-style greatsword. When wielded by Grendel he is immune to staggers and knockdowns during heavy attacks.

Mandonel fires <DT_RADIATION_COLOR>Radiation Damage projectiles. Partially charged shots release a spread and fully charged shots release a beam that dissolves into a radiation field. Projectiles that pass through the field are empowered.

Blast enemies with glass slugs that devastate on impact. In Gara's hands, this signature weapon has a larger Ammo Pool.
Fires razor-sharp darts that anchor themselves in their target before erupting in a plume of toxic gas.

Unfurl this warfan like a rapidly waxing moon.

With a high fire rate, ammo efficiency and rapid reload when emptied, this unusual sidearm can hand out carnage all day long. Ammo efficiency is further increased when Protea uses this, her signature weapon.
Go on the hunt with Oraxia’s signature secondary. Fling a volley of toxin-laced barbs, or drop a cluster snare that scatters on impact, seizing nearby enemies and dragging them together.
The wrath of one who knows revenge is all about timing. Orion's signature Heavy Scythe.
Ring the death knell. Headshots briefly turn this scoped pistol into a rapid-fire, Critical Damage fiend that uses no ammo. When used by Harrow, Knell has a 2-round mag.
Blast targets with corrosive plasma projectiles, or toss the scepter to inflict an energy field upon nearby enemies that amplifies their brain waves to attract bullets.

Like a breath of wind, shots fired by this multi-barrel sniper are felt but never seen by its targets. Headshots in quick succession increase the Perigale's ammo efficiency. When the Perigale is wielded by Voruna, its ammo pool increases.
The steel flag of Old War Railjack crews, the Pennant was invaluable in repelling boarders. With each heavy attack kill the Pennant's speed of attack increases.

The Quellor was standard-issue to Dax Railjack crews of the Old War, dating back to the earliest, pre-Sigma craft. A rapid-fire assault rifle with a hefty magazine-size, the Quellor is an all-round workhorse. Also capable of large, short-range cryo-blasts.
Precise calibration, rapid trigger-pull and a steady hand all combine to bring down the hardiest prey on two legs or four.
Make easy prey of enemies with this quiet, agile, and pinpoint accurate Tenno submachine gun.

From death blooms the Larkspur. A unique and menacing Archgun with a wild initial attack that locks onto a target then chains other targets close to the first. It also sports an explosive projectile mode. In Hildryn's grip the Larkspur carries more reserve ammo.
The pride of one that knows their worth. Sirius' signature Heavy Scythe.

Fearsome and noble, the elegant two-handed Nikana is the pride of any Arsenal. Kills build charges and seeking projectiles are unleashed with a Slide Attack to find and stun unwitting enemies. When Revenant wields this blade, Tatsu's charge cap is increased.
Strike with silent lightning or the pummeling drum of thunder. Alternate between stealthy short-range electrical discharge, and automatic lightning gun. Faster mode-switch when used by Wisp.

Sevagoth's wrist-mounted sidearm fires a chilling slow-moving slab, guaranteed to slow enemies for easier marksmanship. Charge the shot to fire a punishing high-velocity, high critical chance slab that punches through barriers. Deals additional headshot damage in Sevagoth's hands.

An energy projectile bursts forth from the Steflos and grows as it rushes toward enemies. The projectile's duration increases when it hits an enemy. When Citrine fires the Steflos, its projectile speed increases.

Deliver a ruthless barrage of Sentient artillery from this instrument of death. Alt-fire splits the weapon apart into separate rifles, expanding its devastation by tracking up to 4 targets at once, while consuming more ammo per shot.
Forged of steel grafted from Umbra's flesh, this elegant Nikana unites with its Warframe to form a single being of seething purpose.
With a precision crafted lens, this customized Opticor achieves a level of performance previously thought impossible.

The Thalys played a ceremonial role in the Zariman harvest festival, and was intended to reap the first fruits of Tau. Now twisted from this purpose, it plants Void shards in enemy flesh instead. Each new shard planted causes existing shards to inflict damage on their hosts.
Lacerate attackers with two razor sharp warfans.

Mete out the sharp pain of justice. Heavy Slam attacks create a vortex that pulls in lifted enemies when the Sarofang’s Combo Multiplier builds to 8x. In Voruna’s hands, the Sarofang only requires a 5x Combo Multiplier to summon the vortex.
The signature weapon of the only lunatic fearsome enough to bust out of the Saturn Six Max-Pen. Once loosed this formidable throwing hammer always finds its way home.

In the early Orokin Empire, elites wore Innodem as a symbolic reminder to defend the defenseless. The tradition fell out of style, but nostalgic elites acknowledged the sentiment in the form of a gift. The Void amplifies that ideal. Void energy strengthens Innodem gliding aerial attacks and the wielder is increasingly resilient as they perform finisher attacks in Incarnon Form.

During parades and victory marches, the Laetum fired pigmented airburst rounds that rained onto festive crowds. The Orokin sent Laetum with the Zariman so they could properly celebrate a successful maiden voyage to Tau. There would be no such celebration, but the Void imbued the Laetum with a much more explosive capacity.

The Felarx invokes ancient times when aristocrats hunted game. For ceremonies, Orokin elites bred creatures reminiscent of game birds to reanimate cultural myths. They gave the Zariman crew Felarx and a brace of birds as a sign of acceptance into elite society. The brace of birds becomes a pair of pistols at the hands of the Void.

Zariman colonists originally intended to use the Phenmor in burial rites. In Orokin society, the higher the rank, the greater number of volleys for the deceased. Its stock is carved from Phenaureus Pine, a tree designed to release seedlings only onto scorched earth. In the hands of the Void, the Phenmor becomes darkly aggressive.

Orokin elites admired farmers in conquered regions, because they had learned to fight with modified farming tools despite being forbidden to own weapons. For their voyage, the Zariman were presented with Praedos in recognition of Zariman tenacity. The Void reinforces the strength of the spirited individual by fortifying the Praedos.
